summary: Comprehensive first-iteration testing of HaritaPro MVP. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases passed covering auth, user mgmt (owner RBAC), projects (owner CRUD + employee read-only + finance strip for employees), payments (owner only + auto recalc), expenses (owner only), finance summary KPIs, schedules + status transitions, institution steps CRUD, document upload/download via Bearer and file-token, cross-role 403 enforcement. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Login screen renders Turkish UI with required testIDs; Owner login redirects to /projects, Finans tab visible, create-project-fab opens Yeni Proje modal with 6 input fields, Ayarlar screen shows invite-btn + logout-btn + employee list. Employee login hides Finans tab and create-project-fab (shows only Projeler/Takvim/Ayarlar), role badge reads 'Çalışan', empty state 'Henüz bir iş/görev atanmadı' renders correctly, and direct navigation to /finance safely redirects back to /projects. No red screens, no JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 644 lines — within guideline but approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting routers (auth, projects, finance, documents) into modules for long-term maintainability.
/api/schedules POST allows any authenticated user to create a schedule (employee can create their own); confirm this is intended business behavior (currently works and tested).

/api/steps/{sid} PUT and DELETE are open to any authenticated user without checking project assignment — an employee not assigned to a project could update/delete that project's steps if they know the step id. Low risk because ids are UUID but worth tightening scope.
/api/documents/{doc_id} DELETE allows uploader (employee) to delete their own doc even if later unassigned from the project — acceptable but note it.
seed_data_creation: Tests create a unique TEST employee + TEST project + payment + expense + schedule + step + document per run and clean up at the end via test_zz_cleanup. The seeded owner (patron@haritapro.com) is left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Use /app/backend/tests/test_api.py as regression suite. Frontend login/role-gated navigation confirmed working. If adding new features: add testIDs for any new modals/inputs; employee role must never see finance keys (offer_amount, agreed_amount, received_amount, remaining_amount) in /api/projects responses.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
